label: pairwise_artist_signature_camera_composition_006
resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, facial profile, and visible profile eye clearly readable. The second camera direction is the measured axis. Obey its literal crop, side view, field of view, asymmetric placement, and negative-space counterweight. Create a clean hand-drawn two-dimensional editorial illustration. The exact name-free signature controls the visible medium, face, eyes, silhouette, palette, light, composition, and ornament. Make these eight cues bold and unmistakable: line language—precise controlled contours with measured taper; face design—a tapered jaw and high cheekbones; eye design—deep almond eyes with heavy upper rims; body design—a compact grounded full-body stance; palette language—one dominant tint with restrained value shifts; light modeling—velvety diffuse values and soft contact shadows; framing language—a centered emblem-like outer border around the canvas, expressed in the background while the measured camera controls subject placement; ornament language—repeated textile bands and woven motifs. Draw face and eye details crisply within the full-length figure. Put the ornament on both the garment and outer border. Keep the complete figure in front of every decorative framing element. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: Photograph an adult subject using full-length framing with both feet visible and clear space below the subject from a mildly lowered camera position that lengthens the stance without distorting the face. The view uses long-lens compression with flattened depth and carefully separated silhouette edges and asymmetric placement with generous negative space and one clear visual counterweight. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—frame literally from the complete crown through both feet, with generous visible background margin above the hairstyle and below both shoes.
